scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Eml Headers Report
scripts.description: Extract email headers from local .eml files without accessing an inbox or sending messages.

scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: File Permission Audit
scripts.description: Find world-writable regular files under a directory without following symlinks.
scripts.expected_output: JSON list of world-writable files; exit 1 if found.

scripts.title: Folder Inventory
scripts.description: Inventory regular files recursively with size and modification timestamps, exporting structured JSON or CSV.
scripts.expected_output: JSON or CSV list of files and sizes.

scripts.title: Gh Create Repo
scripts.description: Create a repo and optionally init/commit/push a local dir.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Gh Enable Pages
scripts.description: Enable GitHub Pages via the API (Actions or branch source). Repo owner.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Gh Issues Sync
scripts.description: Create issues from a JSON list of `{title, body, labels}`. Missing labels are created first (priority `P1`-`P3`, `area:*` and type labels get consistent colors); an issue whose title already exists, open or closed, is skipped, so re-runs never duplicate. Preview by default (exit 2 when there is something to create).
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Gh Merge Pr
scripts.description: Merge a PR safely: polls mergeability, refuses `CONFLICTING`, confirms first.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Gh Org Ci
scripts.description: Latest GitHub Actions runs for every repo of an org (or `--repos`), one table, with the URL of each failed run. `--wait` polls until nothing is running; exit code 2 when any shown run failed.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Gh Org Clone
scripts.description: Clone every repo of an org into one directory; `--pull` fast-forwards existing clones (dirty ones are skipped, never reset).
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Gh Pr Open
scripts.description: Push the current branch and open a PR in one step.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Gh Pr Status
scripts.description: One table of every open PR with CI / review / mergeable state.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Gh Release
scripts.description: Bump version, build a changelog from commits since the last tag, tag, and release.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Gh Rename Org
scripts.description: Rename an organization. Checks you own it and the new name is free, opens the settings page (github.com has no rename API), waits until GitHub serves the new name, repoints remotes under `--scan-dir`, and lists files still naming the old org.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Gh Rename Repo
scripts.description: Rename a repo and rewrite the local `origin`.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Git Clean Branches
scripts.description: Delete branches already merged into the base (local, and `--remote`).
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Git Conflict Helper
scripts.description: Rule-based guide to merge/rebase conflicts. See [Resolving conflicts](conflicts.md).
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Git Replace
scripts.description: Replace a literal string in every tracked text file. Preview by default (exit 2 when matches exist), `--apply` to write; pathspecs include or exclude files.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Git Safe Checkout
scripts.description: Switch branches without silently losing uncommitted work.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Git Split Repo
scripts.description: Extract files or directories into a new repo, keeping their commit history (via `git-filter-repo`). Paths can be moved, including to the root; the source repo is never modified. `--publish` creates the GitHub repo and pushes.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Git Sync
scripts.description: Catch up: fetch, fast-forward base, prune, rebase current branch. Refuses a dirty tree.
scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.

scripts.title: Http Status Check
scripts.description: Check HTTP response status and elapsed time for one URL with a configurable timeout.

scripts.title: Incremental File Copy

scripts.expected_output: Planned or copied file paths; destination never pruned.

scripts.expected_output: Command output; see --help and script reference.
